title: WorldToggle
description: WorldToggle is a lightweight and seamless administration tool that lets you instantly enable or disable access to the Nether and End dimensions without restarting your server.
body:
WorldToggle is a lightweight, highly efficient Minecraft server plugin that gives administrators complete control over dimension access. Whether you want to temporarily close the Nether for a server event, restrict End access until a certain progression milestone is met, or toggle dimensions on the fly without restarting your server, WorldToggle makes it effortless.

### 🛠 Commands & Permissions

* `/nether <on/off>` – Enables or disables access to the Nether dimension. (Permission: `worldtoggle.admin`)
* `/end <on/off>` – Enables or disables access to the End dimension. (Permission: `worldtoggle.admin`)
* `/worldtoggle reload` – Reloads the plugin configuration files. (Permission: `worldtoggle.admin`)
